name: Distro 10 - Edible Gummies 200mg - Mango Sensation
description:
Big flavor in a small bite. Distro 10 Mango Sensation gummies deliver bold tropical mango taste — sweet, juicy, and bursting with flavor in every piece.

Each pack contains 10 gummies at 20mg each — 200mg total — so it's easy to dial in exactly the dose you want. Perfectly soft, perfectly sweet, and ready whenever you are.

10 gummies × 20mg — 200mg per pack
Bold Mango Sensation flavor — sweet, juicy tropical mango
Easy to portion — consistent dosing in every piece

Start low, go slow, and enjoy the ride.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
